items.stem: Under Dart sound null safety, what does declaring a variable as String? (with a question mark) mean?

options.text: The variable may hold a String or null, and the compiler forces you to handle the null case
options.rationale: Correct: the ? makes the type nullable and the compiler requires null-aware handling before use.

options.text: The variable can never be null
options.rationale: That describes a non-nullable String, written without the question mark.

options.text: The variable is automatically initialised to an empty string
options.rationale: Nullable variables default to null, not an empty string.

options.text: The question mark converts the value to a number if possible
options.rationale: ? marks nullability; it performs no conversion.

items.explanation: Correct: the ? makes the type nullable and the compiler requires null-aware handling before use.

items.stem: Which statements about async/await in Dart are correct? (Select TWO)

options.text: await suspends the current function until the Future completes, without blocking the event loop
options.rationale: Correct: await yields control back to the event loop and resumes when the Future resolves.

options.text: A function using await must be marked async
options.rationale: Correct: await is only allowed inside a function declared async.

options.text: async/await runs the awaited work on a separate OS thread
options.rationale: Dart is single-threaded per isolate; async does not create threads.

options.text: await turns a synchronous function into a parallel loop
options.rationale: await does not parallelise loops; it sequences asynchronous steps.

items.explanation: Correct: await yields control back to the event loop and resumes when the Future resolves.; Correct: await is only allowed inside a function declared async.

items.stem: What is the main purpose of a mixin in Dart?

options.text: To reuse a set of methods across classes without forcing a single inheritance chain
options.rationale: Correct: mixins let unrelated classes share behaviour via with, avoiding deep inheritance.
Mixins are a code-reuse mechanism, not storage.

options.text: To mark a class as unable to be instantiated
options.rationale: That is the role of abstract, not a mixin.

options.text: To make all fields nullable automatically
options.rationale: Mixins do not change nullability of fields.

items.explanation: Correct: mixins let unrelated classes share behaviour via with, avoiding deep inheritance.
